description: AGRIBALYSE takes sulfur from `Resources / in water` in 24 exchanges whose every amount is zero -- 23 literal zeros and one `0,327*0`, in amino-acid fermentation datasets and one sulfuric-acid process -- while taking it from `Resources / in ground` 2,182 times with real amounts. EF 3.1 publishes `Sulfur` as a ground resource with a factor; the list has no from-water sulfur flow, so on the build of 1 September 2026 (run c5445e95) the water row minted a second `Sulfur` in `Resource → Water → Unknown` with no factor, one of the 15 items on the substance-in-two-places queue. The fix re-files the row to `Resources / in ground` in `agribalyse-3.2-manual-fixes.json`: the same element from the same crust, the water subcompartment a SimaPro bookkeeping slot rather than a claim about the sea, and every use zero so no inventory result moves. See #368 and plans in agribalyse-land-and-sulfur-contexts.md §2.

expectations.title: AGRIBALYSE's sulfur-from-water row reaches the Sulfur ground resource EF publishes
expectations.comment: On the build of 1 September 2026 the row matched the Sulfur substance by its number and then minted a new flow in `Resource → Water → Unknown` because no water flow existed. Re-filed, it lands on the ground flow with EF's factor.

expectations.title: Sulfur is published as a resource in one context, not two
expectations.comment: The minted water flow of the build of 1 September 2026, gone once the one row that produced it is re-filed.
